notes: The registry record hasResults is false and contains no resultsSection; counts and ownership therefore come from the abstract. Selected death from any cause within 90 days after randomization. The abstract reports randomized totals of 2515 (BMES) and 2522 (saline), but explicitly gives mortality denominators of 2433 and 2413; the latter are used without imputing outcomes for the full randomized population. The registry protocol also lists ICU, hospital and 28 day all-cause mortality, but supplies no counts for those timepoints. No other mortality count candidates are printed in the packet.
